meaning:
Διόσ-κουροι, -ων, οἱ
(Ion. and κοινή form of Att..., Διόσκοροι; Διός, genitive of Ζεύς + κόρος, a son),
the Dioscuri (Castor and Pollux), twin sons of Zeus and Leda (RV, The Twin Brothers): Act.28:11.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: After three months, we set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose sign was “The Twin Brothers.”
